# Qema Tech — قمة تك (qema-tech.com)

Qema Tech (قمة تك) is an Egyptian software studio and digital commerce engineering company building Shopify and WordPress/WooCommerce stores alongside proprietary Cloud Commerce, Enterprise ERP, Salon, Restaurant & Fitness SaaS platforms across Egypt and Saudi Arabia.

## Key URLs
- Arabic Main Site: https://qema-tech.com/
- English Site: https://qema-tech.com/en/
- Shopify Store Development: https://qema-tech.com/shopify-stores/ (EN: /en/shopify-stores/)
- WordPress & WooCommerce Agency: https://qema-tech.com/wordpress-development/ (EN: /en/wordpress-development/)
- Enterprise ERP & Cloud Systems: https://qema-tech.com/erp-systems/ (EN: /en/erp-systems/)
- Email: info@qema-tech.com
- WhatsApp: +20 112 503 0642

## Proprietary Cloud Products (SaaS & Enterprise)
1. **Easyfy** (https://easyfy.cloud/): Cloud Commerce, POS, Multi-Branch Inventory, Smart Exchanges, Courier COD Custody, Wholesale Packaging Store — Two-way sync with Shopify, WooCommerce & EasyOrders. Transparent monthly/annual tiers.
2. **Ebmspro** (https://ebms.online/ — Easy Business Management System): Complete Egyptian & MENA Enterprise ERP and Offline-Ready POS suite covering Multi-Branch Inventory (variants/batch/serials), Double-Entry Accounting, 14% VAT compliance, Purchasing & Suppliers, Customers & Credit Limits, and interactive online Demo.
3. **Engaz PRO** (https://engazpro.com/): Standalone Salon, Beauty Center, Spa & Barbershop booking + management platform with 24/7 customer booking site on custom domain, appointment calendar, POS cashier, staff commissions, inventory & branch profit accounting. Live client deployment: **Samaka Salon** (https://samaka-salon.com/).
4. **Masa QR** (https://masa-qr.site/): Live restaurant reservations, QR menu and online ordering platform demo.
5. **Sanadat** (https://sanadat.site/): Simple workflow & business management workspace built for freelancers.
6. **Anoofit** (https://anoofit.site/): Gym coach & client subscription management platform.
